assumptions: Midpoint propagation plus endpoint-only settling tail; measured output slew supplies each receiving input ramp.

measurement: 1 ns ramp start to final entry into the ideal ±0.5 V band through the full segment; 2 ns maximum timestep; independent integer dot-product oracle; nominal 27 °C.
limits: Finite fixed-weight vector pairs; matched STA is not a global timing bound. Ideal ±5/0 V supply sources. No rail IR, signal wire R, PVT sweep, or calibrated sign-off PEX. Wire C is area/perimeter based with published estimator assumptions. Drawing-deck DRC and strict device/port LVS do not establish MPW mask sign-off. Source expression is left associative and is lowered by the public synthesizer; no manual balancing.
